messages:
Marina K: Heads-up — postmortem follow-ups from last night's high-tail-latency incident. I'm opening a PR to update the playbook with clearer triage commands and an escalation path. Please indicate owners and timelines here.
Alex P: Thanks — can you paste the exact triage commands you want in the playbook? makes it easier for oncall to run quickly :+1:
Marina K: Sure. Proposed snippet to add under 'initial triage':
```
# check cluster cpu/gpu pressure
kubectl top nodes
# tail inference runtime logs for error spikes
kubectl logs -n inference -l app=runtime -f --tail=200
# check kv-cache hit rate (internal metric)
curl -s http://metrics.internal/kv_cache/hit_rate | jq .
```
Also adding a short checklist to validate backups/rate-limited batch jobs during midnight window.
Jamal R: I can own the KV-cache hit-rate remediation and follow-up. Will review metrics dashboards and propose alert thresholds. Assign to me please.
Marina K: Assigned Jamal — action: "investigate/adjust kv-cache policy" owner=Jamal R due=2025-05-07
Olivia S: I'll take the playbook wording and PR review. ETA for the PR? We should turn the triage snippet into a single runnable script too.
Marina K: Opening PR now: https://github.com/redwood-inference/playbooks/pull/312 — includes commands, escalation matrix, and a short canary checklist. Please comment on wording.
sre-bot: Reminder: file changed in docs/playbooks/incident-triage.md by Marina K at 2025-05-01T02:34:10Z
Alex P: Noted. For escalation path: suggest adding explicit SLA gates — if 5 minute 99thP > 1.2x baseline for > 10m, page -> oncall -> infra lead -> eng-runtime. Also include contact numbers and PagerDuty schedule link.
Marina K: Good. I'll add the SLA thresholds and link to PD schedule. Also adding a recurring item to the incident tracker: we're seeing similar tail latency on 00:00-04:00 UTC over 3 incidents this quarter — likely correlated with backup+batch traffic.
Jamal R: For remediation timeline: I'll have a metrics analysis and alert proposal by 2025-05-05. If we decide to change caching policy, that will need a canary on dedicated pool — target rollout by 2025-05-12 with rollback plan.
Olivia S: I'll finish wording + script and open a follow-up docs PR by EOD tomorrow 2025-05-02.
Marina K: Action items summary (from thread):
- Jamal R: analyze kv-cache hit patterns, propose alert thresholds, due 2025-05-05
- Jamal R: implement canary change plan (if approved), target 2025-05-12
- Olivia S: PR review + script for triage commands, due 2025-05-02
- Marina K: add SLA gates + PD schedule to playbook, link postmortem, PR #312
- Alex P: confirm escalation contact order and add infra lead contact, due 2025-05-03
I'll update the incident tracker and add a recurring-incident tag to the postmortem so we get quarterly review reminders.
Alex P: Can we add a short troubleshooting section for 'failed prefix cache warm-up' and the quick rollback command? helped us last night.
Marina K: Yes — adding snippet:
```
# rollback to previous model shard config
redwoodctl rollout rollback --service inference-runtime --to-revision v1.8.3
# disable batch jobs temporarily
kubectl annotate cronjob nightly-batch suspend=true --overwrite
```
Olivia S: Looks good. I'll make the triage script run those checks and print next steps.
deploy-bot: Deploy gateway v2.14.1 started by Olivia S — logs: https://deploys.internal/1129
Marina K: Thanks all. I'll close this thread once PR #312 is merged and the incident tracker updated. Please add any other follow-ups here or comment on the PR. :rocket:
